11std::pair<std::vector<uint8_t>, size_t>
12Encoding::packOperationsToNibbles(const std::vector<OpEntry>& operations)
13{
14 // Bytes = final packed stream (each byte = 2 nibbles)
15 // isLeaf = parallel array tagging each nibble as leaf/interior
16 //
17 // Always 1 entry per nibble, including delta nibbles.
18
19 std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
20
21 // Reserve some memory to reduce reallocations
22 bytes.reserve((operations.size() * 3) / 2);
23
24 size_t nibbleCount = 0; // Track actual nibbles (excluding padding)
25
26 // ------------------------------------------------------------
27 // Nibble-pairing state
28 // If haveHigh==false → next nibble becomes the high nibble
29 // If haveHigh==true → next nibble completes the byte
30 bool haveHigh = false;
31 uint8_t highNib = 0;
32 // ------------------------------------------------------------
33
34 // ------------------------------------------------------------
35 // Helper: push one 4-bit nibble
36 auto pushNibble = [&](uint8_t nib)
37 {
38 nib &= 0x0F; // Keep only 4 bits
39 nibbleCount++; // Count actual nibbles
40
41 if (!haveHigh)
42 {
43 // Store as high nibble of next byte
44 highNib = nib;
45 haveHigh = true;
46 }
47 else
48 {
49 // Complete byte by combining high + low nibble
50 uint8_t byte = (highNib << 4) | nib;
51 bytes.push_back(byte);
52 haveHigh = false;
53 }
54 };
55 // ------------------------------------------------------------
56
57
58 // ------------------------------------------------------------
59 // Main packing loop
60 for (const auto& e : operations)
61 {
62 // Build primary nibble:
63 //
64 // [ opCode (3 bits) | stopBit (1 bit, LSB) ]
65 //
66 uint8_t opCode = static_cast<uint8_t>(e.op);
67 uint8_t primaryNibble = (opCode << 1) | (e.stopBit & 1);
68
69 // Push primary nibble (always one)
70 pushNibble(primaryNibble);
71
72 // If Pδ: push delta nibble (second nibble of the op)
73 if (e.op == OpType::PaletteBackD)
74 {
75 uint8_t deltaNibble = e.delta & 0x0F;
76 pushNibble(deltaNibble);
77 }
78 }
79 // ------------------------------------------------------------
80
81
82 // ------------------------------------------------------------
83 // If a high nibble is left without a partner, pad low nibble = 0
84 if (haveHigh)
85 {
86 bytes.push_back(highNib << 4); // low nibble = 0 (padding, not counted)
87 }
88
89 return { bytes, nibbleCount };
90 // ------------------------------------------------------------
91}

146RansModel Encoding::buildRansModel(const FrequencyTable& rawTable)
147{
148 const size_t N = rawTable.size();
149
150 RansModel model;
151 model.freq.resize(N);
152 model.cumulativeFreq.resize(N + 1);
153
154 // Replace zeros with 1
155 uint64_t rawSum = 0;
156 for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
157 uint32_t f = rawTable[i];
158 if (f == 0) f = 1;
159 model.freq[i] = f;
160 rawSum += f;
161 }
162
163 // Normalize to RANS_TOTAL
164 uint64_t normSum = 0;
165 for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
166 uint64_t scaled = (model.freq[i] * (uint64_t)RANS_TOTAL) / rawSum;
167 if (scaled == 0) scaled = 1; // MUST remain ≥1
168 model.freq[i] = (uint32_t)scaled;
169 normSum += scaled;
170 }
171
172 //Fix rounding drift
173 while (normSum < RANS_TOTAL) {
174 model.freq[0]++; // add slack somewhere
175 normSum++;
176 }
177 while (normSum > RANS_TOTAL) {
178 size_t largest = 0;
179 for (size_t i = 1; i < N; ++i)
180 if (model.freq[i] > model.freq[largest])
181 largest = i;
182 if (model.freq[largest] > 1) {
183 model.freq[largest]--;
184 normSum--;
185 } else break;
186 }
187
188 // Build cumulative freq
189 uint32_t acc = 0;
190 for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
191 model.cumulativeFreq[i] = acc;
192 acc += model.freq[i];
193 }
194 model.cumulativeFreq[N] = acc;
195
196 model.totalFreq = acc;
197 assert(model.totalFreq == RANS_TOTAL);
198
199 return model;
200}

202void Encoding::ransEncodeSymbol(
203uint32_t& state,
204std::vector<uint8_t>& out, // <-- OUTPUT BYTE STREAM
205uint8_t symbol,
206const RansModel& model)
207{
208 uint32_t freq = model.freq[symbol];
209 uint32_t start = model.cumulativeFreq[symbol];
210
211 // Renormalize
212 while (state >= ((RANS_LIMIT >> LOG_TOTAL_FREQ) << 8) * freq)
213 {
214 out.push_back(state & 0xFF);
215 state >>= 8;
216 }
217
218 state = ((state / freq) * model.totalFreq) + (state % freq) + start;
219 }
